name: 23 herb formula to increase breast milk
indication: Promote the quality and quantity of milk
indication_description: This is a natural formula meant to promote the quality and quantity of milk. This is 100% safe and effective. It can be used as a tonic for physically weak nursing mothers. Breast milk production may increase within a couple of days. However, in order to ensure the best results, the mother should continue taking this preparation for at least 15 days.
